pr_body:
When merging plain lists we shouldn't cast them to `List<Map<String, V>>. If we do that we get a `ClassCastException` in runtime during iteration, e.g. if the list contains strings, not maps.

This issue has been already fixed in 8.0 during one of the refactorings, but it hasn't been fixed in 7.x.

Fixes #78211

issue_context.title: Dynamic date formats in legacy templates cannot merge in 7.x
issue_context.body:
In the 7.x (7.15+) branch, two legacy templates that both have a `dynamic_date_formats` parameter cannot be merged when creating an index.

Here is an example reproduction:

```
PUT /_template/template1
{
  "index_patterns" : ["myindex-*"],
  "mappings" : {
    "dynamic_date_formats" : [
      "strict_date_optional_time",
      "yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss Z||yyyy/MM/dd Z"
    ]
  }
}

PUT /_template/template2
{
  "index_patterns" : ["myindex-*"],
  "mappings" : {
    "dynamic_date_formats" : [
      "strict_date_optional_time",
      "yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss Z||yyyy/MM/dd Z"
    ]
  }
}

PUT /myindex-foo
```

When the index is created it returns the following error:

```
{
  "error" : {
    "root_cause" : [
      {
        "type" : "class_cast_exception",
        "reason" : "class java.lang.String cannot be cast to class java.util.Map (java.lang.String and java.util.Map are in module java.base of loader 'bootstrap')"
      }
    ],
    "type" : "class_cast_exception",
    "reason" : "class java.lang.String cannot be cast to class java.util.Map (java.lang.String and java.util.Map are in module java.base of loader 'bootstrap')"
  },
  "status" : 500
}
```

review_comments: Since these are exactly the same strings, it's difficult to tell whether the merging actually happened in the right order from this test. Could you change one of the formats?
:+1: This test verified the behaviour from the SDH ticket where `XContentHelper` threw an exception on the same strings. I will add another test with different formats.
